core.title: Courier rule change at Pemberton & Vale
core.setting: Law firm office administrator at Pemberton & Vale Solicitors, a six-lawyer firm

events.text: FastLine Couriers confirms its standard rates for Pemberton & Vale: local document bundle deliveries within Leeds run between 30 and 40 pounds depending on size, booked through Priya Nair.
SafeStore Archive confirms that a run of archive boxes from Pemberton & Vale to the SafeStore facility on Whitehall Road costs about 30 pounds per delivery.
Harriet Doyle at Bramford Developments writes that the commercial lease matter is active and that signed lease bundles should be delivered to her office at 22 Call Lane, Leeds.
Alana Reyes confirms her purchase completion is planned for early November and asks that the completion papers be delivered to her home at 14 Marlowe Road, Leeds.
Office rule: any change to the agreed cost of a booked supplier delivery, whatever the amount, must be signed off by finance lead Marcus Hale before the booking is altered.
Sonia Blight confirms chambers availability for a joint conference in the autumn and suggests their seminar rooms on Park Row, Leeds.

Office rule: every outgoing document bundle from Pemberton & Vale goes by FastLine Couriers, and any single delivery costing more than 40 pounds needs finance lead Marcus Hale's sign-off before it is booked.
Marcus Hale is the firm's finance lead and handles all supplier sign-offs and invoice approvals.
SafeStore Archive invoices the firm 210 pounds for quarterly storage of closed files at the Whitehall Road facility.
Booked a FastLine Couriers delivery of the signed Bramford lease bundle to Harriet Doyle at 22 Call Lane for 2026-10-27, at FastLine's quoted rate of 32 pounds, within the 40 pound sign-off limit.
Marcus Hale reminds fee earners that all supplier invoices should reach him by the 25th of each month for payment runs.
Minutes of the July practice meeting: the six lawyers confirmed autumn filing deadlines and agreed to keep the shared diary updated weekly.
To-do: chase Bramford Developments for the remaining signed lease pages by 2026-10-15 so the October bundle is complete.
Following the Bramford bundle booking, booked a FastLine Couriers delivery of Alana Reyes's completion papers to 14 Marlowe Road for 2026-11-03, ahead of her early-November completion, at 38 pounds.
The firm's offices are at Regent House, 8 Crown Street, Leeds; reception opens at 08:30 and the post goes out at 16:00 daily.

Booked a FastLine Couriers run of closed-file archive boxes to SafeStore Archive on Whitehall Road for 2026-10-30 at their quoted 30 pounds, below the 40 pound sign-off threshold so no finance sign-off was sought.
Sent the Hartley wills bundle to the district probate registry by FastLine Couriers on 2026-09-15 at 35 pounds, within the 40 pound sign-off limit; the delivery completed the same day.
CityDash Couriers sends an unsolicited quote: flat 24 pounds for any local document run within Leeds, account opening available on request.
Booked Chambers Suite A at Blight & Co Chambers on Park Row for the joint conference with Sonia Blight on 2026-11-10 at 10:00.
Regent House management gives notice of lift maintenance on 2026-09-18; deliveries that day should use the service entrance.
Ordered 20 bundles of flat-pack archive boxes from SafeStore Archive for delivery to Regent House, 8 Crown Street, confirmed for 2026-10-22.

FastLine Couriers confirms the current Pemberton & Vale bookings: the Bramford lease bundle on 2026-10-27 at 32 pounds, the Reyes completion papers on 2026-11-03 at 38 pounds, and the SafeStore archive run on 2026-10-30 at 30 pounds.
FastLine Couriers confirms the Hartley wills bundle was delivered to the district probate registry today and signed for at 11:20.

Following the quarterly supplier review, from 1 October all outgoing document bundles from the firm go by SwiftRun Couriers at their flat rate of 18 pounds per local delivery, and the finance sign-off threshold for any single delivery drops from 40 pounds to 25 pounds; bookings made for dates before 1 October are unaffected.
Leon Pike at SwiftRun Couriers confirms the Pemberton & Vale account is live, with bookings taken by email and a flat 18 pound rate for local Leeds document deliveries.
Harriet Doyle sends the remaining signed lease pages and confirms the Bramford bundle can go out as planned.
To-do: pay SwiftRun Couriers' first monthly invoice by 2026-11-15 once Marcus Hale has checked it.
Alana Reyes asks whether anything is needed from her before completion; she is at home most weekdays to receive papers.
Minutes of the October practice meeting: completion dates for November were confirmed and admin were asked to keep courier bookings under review.
Harriet Doyle says she will be in the Call Lane office all week and any weekday delivery suits her.
